Create：完美加工！

This mod adds recipes, tweaks and balances to Create for you to expand your automation empire with. It is developed as part of the Whiskers and Wonders modpack for Mr. Beardstone's patreon server, but fits right in with any modpack that also uses the Create mod. Recipes included make several blocks and items renewable, such as asurine, calcite or phantom membranes.

特色/配方

  • 自動化Create裝飾性方塊如：阿斯林、克里姆石、歐克魯姆和維里迪烏姆
  • 自動化方塊及礦物如：方解石、深板岩、鐘乳石凝灰岩、地獄岩和古塵
  • 自動化黃金、鋅、青金石、幽靈膜和鈮金屬
  • 步驟的邏輯與現實應用，例如使用壓力、碳和熱量來生產鑽石
  • 兼容Vanilla Backport和Create，將木質方塊加入適當的標籤中
  • Splementaries的鐵錠歌曲平衡分配更均勻
  • 此mod亦可用於Skyblock挑戰來進行更多自動化操作

致謝

  • 感謝Mr. Beardstone開發了精彩的 Perfect World 2: More Perfecter modpack
  • PW2服務器小組 (Dragonll237, GunHippy, Doppel_R, EsmeTH) 協助配方協作

This mod is a successor 1.21.1 to Create Skyblock Tweaks.
